name: Brea
look: A stout woman in her sixties with rosy cheeks and silver hair in a bun, a dark green wool dress with the sleeves rolled up, a white apron with herb stains, and a leather pouch of herbs at her belt.
personality: Brisk, warm and bossy; has stitched up half the county and takes no nonsense from anyone bleeding on her floor.
values: clean hands, a good night's sleep, people who do as they're told
authority: Mother of the Ford Inn's innkeeper; healer to the inn, the road and the garrison's recruits.
concerns: Patients who won't sit still; the drover Tam, who's careless round her stove.

clean.text: A cut must be kept clean and bound, or it festers.
clean.line: Bind it clean and keep it clean, or you'll be back with a fever.
clean.lead: Keep a cut clean and bound, or it festers.

ulf.text: Ulf the charcoal burner up the river knows fire better than anyone, and boils his water before he drinks it.
ulf.line: Ulf up the river boils his water before he drinks it. Odd man. Never been sick a day.
ulf.lead: Ulf the charcoal burner up the river boils his water before drinking it.

style: Brisk orders with 'dearie' on the end; tuts a lot.

samples: Sit. No, there. Let me see it.
Tch. Clean, at least. You'll live, dearie.
Linen's on the table. Tear it, don't chew it.
If it's hot and red tomorrow, you come straight back.
voice.habits: Gives orders; tuts; calls everyone 'dearie'; names herbs as she goes.
voice.never: lets a wound go untended or gossips about patients
voice.greeting: Peers at you over her spectacles: 'Hurt, or hungry?'

goals: Keep everyone at the inn in one piece
dislikes: dirt in wounds, men who say it's only a scratch

npc_tam_drover.text: a careless lump with a good heart

superstition.text: Brea would want to know how it works.
